requests.why: `--for 해열제`·`투약`은 0건, `--for 발열`은 기전 클립(m_virus_replication)만 나온다. 행위 48종 중 가장 가까운 act_take_supplement은 한 손을 입으로 올려 알약을 털어 넣는 장면이라 '남에게 먹일 액상 약을 눈금까지 재는' 동작이 아니고, 색인 주의문도 '경구↔주사 혼동'을 이유로 다른 제형에 쓰지 말라고 못박았다. act_shaky_hands는 컵을 쥔 손 떨림이라 계량 동작이 없다. 이 편은 갈림길 셋 중 둘(간격·몸무게)이 '정확한 양'에 걸려 있고 마무리도 '눈금 있는 투약 주사기를 약통 옆에 두라'여서, 눈금까지 재고 공기를 빼는 손이 왼쪽 행위 칸에 있어야 말과 화면이 붙는다.
requests.midjourney: Medical holographic visualization of a pair of translucent glass-like 3D anatomical hands and forearms, the skin rendered as an almost fully transparent thin glass shell with the finger bones and tendons visible inside in soft pale cyan, no face, no head and no body anywhere in the frame, holding a plain slim oral dosing syringe upright over a small unlabelled medicine bottle standing on a flat surface, the syringe barrel showing only a row of fine engraved tick marks and no numbers, letters or printed markings of any kind, the bottle blank and smooth with no label, in a dark empty slate blue-grey studio void, cinematic soft rim lighting, vertical 9:16 portrait frame, the hands and the syringe filling the centre of the frame with clear margins on all sides, absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. The liquid inside the syringe barrel is a soft amber; everything else stays pale cyan. --ar 9:16 --no text, letters, numbers, numerals, printed scale numbers, printed label, brand marking, arrows, watermark, logo, UI, interface, opaque skin, photorealistic skin, face, head, body, figure, person, hypodermic needle, blood
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. Only two translucent glass hands, an oral dosing syringe and a small blank bottle are ever in frame — no face, no head, no body, and nothing else enters the frame at any point. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the left hand clamps the small bottle down against the surface while the right hand drives the syringe tip into its neck, and the camera swings down and in along the barrel until it is running level with the tick marks. 1.5-3s: the right thumb and forefinger draw the plunger back in one slow unbroken pull, never in stages, and soft amber liquid climbs the clear barrel and stops dead level with one engraved tick, the tick lines staying bare. 3-4.5s: the syringe lifts clear of the bottle and turns tip-up, one fingertip flicks the side of the barrel twice with a short sharp tap each time, and a single trapped bubble shakes loose, rises through the amber liquid and is pushed out of the tip as the plunger nudges up a hair. 4.5-6s: the hands hold the syringe dead still and the camera stops hard on the barrel, the amber liquid settling exactly back onto that same tick and staying softly lit until the very last frame, every other thing in frame staying soft pale cyan and the dark slate blue-grey void staying empty. The hands stay translucent glass with the finger bones visible inside throughout. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame; nothing in the frame carries printed markings of any kind. The audio is a low synth drone with two short dry taps as the barrel is flicked, no music, no dialogue.
